data.limits: Two native binary SHA checks verify unchanged stored model bytes; no repeated numerical model validation or MCMC execution. Runtime timings are operational evidence, not performance scores. All future interpretation and ranking remain outside this review.
data.scope: Actual observed post-migration continuation of exactly two closed confirmation jobs; no claim that the remaining live campaign is complete.

data.scope: Independent review of immutable applied migration evidence while the destination coordinator is active. Counts describe the migration snapshot, not current campaign completion.

operations.scope: attempt wall seconds include reload/resume overhead; unique fit receipts are counted once; no CPU-seconds interpretation
